_readme: Squad Battles weekly ranking settings (bands: FIFA 21 retail), ported from the Python server (f354894, a4fdc85).
The reward tiers are a table since migration 133, edited in the operator panel (Modes, Squad Battles); a fresh database is seeded from
rewards/squad_battles.json. Six Top slots take their places from squad_battles.json competition.boardSize (the Top players number); there is no band sizing.
Loaded at server start and validated strictly (an invalid file stops the server).
mode 'percentile' = retail FIFA 21: a tier needs its band of all players with points (Elite 1 = top 3% ...) and its minPoints;
mode 'points' = fixed thresholds: a player reaches a tier with minPoints or more.
rankedTiers: the Top slots pay once minParticipants players have points; enabled false pays everyone by tier.
minPointsToQualify: a club needs this many points in a week to be placed at all.
